item.title: UPKL Season 2: Ganga Kings Of Mirzapur Derail Gazab Ghaziabad’s Top-four Hopes In A Do-or-Die Week Clash
item.description: Uttar Pradesh Kabaddi League: Ganga Kings of Mirzapur prevailed over Gazab Ghaziabad and derailed their hopes of making it to the top-four stage of Season 2 of the Uttar Pradesh Kabaddi League (UPKL) in Noida on Thursday.

item.title: Sri Lanka vs Pakistan, 2nd T20I- Who will win today SL vs PAK match?
item.description: The second T20I between Sri Lanka and Pakistan will be played on Friday at Rangiri Dambulla International Stadium, Dambulla. Pakistan won the first game by six wickets.

item.title: Khelo India Beach Games Is 'huge Platform', Grateful To PM Modi For It, Says Odisha's Umabati Patra, Gold Medallist In Pencak Silat
item.description: The Khelo India Beach Games: Till two years back, there was no opportunity for lakhs of talented youngsters around the country to participate in major beach games. The Khelo India Beach Games, currently being held in Daman and Diu, has come out as a great opportunity for these sportspersons to showcase their talent and hope to make it to the international stage from there.

item.title: Mumbai Indians Women vs Royal Challengers Bengaluru Women, Match 1, WPL 2026, Who will win today MI-W vs RCB-W match?
item.description: Mumbai Indians Women and Royal Challengers Bengaluru Women will take on each other in the first game of the Women's Premier League 2026 on Friday in DY Patil Stadium.

item.title: Spanish Super Cup Offers Villarreal A Chance To Close Gap In La Liga
item.description: Spanish Super Cup: Although many eyes will be on Jeddah for the Spanish Supercup final on Sunday - featuring Barcelona, Real Madrid, Atlético Madrid, and Athletic Bilbao - the other 16 La Liga sides are in action in what promises to be a key weekend.

item.title: New Zealand's Vellore-born Spinner Adithya Ashok Relishes Prospect Of Bowling To Kohli, Rohit
item.description: New Zealand Cricket: New Zealand’s Vellore-born leg-spinner Adithya Ashok says he is excited to test his bowling against India batting greats Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma in the upcoming three-game ODI series starting in Vadodara on Sunday.

item.title: Courtois Keeps Atletico At Bay To Power Real Madrid Into Spanish Super Cup Final
item.description: Spanish Super Cup: Federico Valverde and Rodrygo scored and goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois made a series of fine saves as Real Madrid beat Atletico Madrid 2-1 to qualify for Sunday's Spanish Super Cup final against FC Barcelona.

item.title: Wawrinka, Thompson, O’Connell Get Australian Open Wildcards
item.description: Australians Jordan Thompson: Former champion Stan Wawrinka and Australians Jordan Thompson and Chris O’Connell have been awarded wildcards for Australian Open maind draw, which begins January 18 at Melbourne Park.

item.title: Mahboob Khan To Lead Afghanistan's 15-man Squad For U19 World Cup
item.description: U19 World Cup: Afghanistan have announced their 15-member squad for the U19 Men's Cricket World Cup 2026 with Mahboob Khan leading the side that boasts a host of talented players.
